Every option control on this page is deliberately hostile: a plain div trigger, a menu created under document.body on click, and entries with no role of any kind. Nothing here can be found by aria-controls, role="listbox", role="menu", or a portal data attribute — which is exactly what a live employer portal ships and exactly what the declared routes cannot see.
